boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain CUNY City College
boards.description: When the North Academic Complex library winds down, CCNY students head to these Harlem and Hamilton Heights staples for fuel, from 24-hour diners to legendary pan-fried chicken.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Broadway Anchor
cards.subtitle: 3543 Broadway
cards.notes: Located just a few blocks from the South Campus, this 24/7 location is a reliable stop for students pulling all-nighters or returning from late lab sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast food staple located on Broadway near 145th Street, serving the CCNY community at all hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 3543-49 Broadway is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for both the restaurant and lobby.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in New York, NY at 3543-49 Broadway | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: Midnight Caffeine at 145th
cards.subtitle: 356 W 145th St
cards.notes: A primary caffeine source for the northern end of campus, this 24-hour spot is conveniently located near the 145th Street subway station used by many commuters.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour coffee and donut shop situated near the 145th Street subway hub, serving students day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 356 W 145th St is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 356 W 145th St in New York | Coffee & Donuts Near You
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: The Late-Night Sugar Fix
cards.subtitle: 17 W 125th St
cards.notes: A short trip south to 125th Street provides access to warm cookies until well past midnight, a favorite for student groups and dorm residents.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery specializing in warm cookies, open until 1:00 AM or later for pickup and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies on 125th Street is open for pickup until 12:35 AM and delivery until late night.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies Delivery Menu | Order Online | 17 W 125th St New York | Grubhub
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:35 AM or later depending on the day.

cards.title: Harlem's Soul Food Flagship
cards.subtitle: 340 W 145th St
cards.notes: Famous for its pan-fried technique, this flagship location serves hearty soul food plates until 11 PM on weekends, perfect for a late dinner.
cards.short_summary: A legendary Harlem eatery known for pan-fried chicken and Southern sides, open late on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harlem flagship location at 340 W 145th St is open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Locations - Charles Pan-Fried Chicken
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday; 10 PM other nights.

cards.title: The 5 AM Cravings Stop
cards.subtitle: 161 E 125th St
cards.notes: For those truly late nights, this 125th Street location stays open until 5 AM, offering a full menu of tacos and burritos for the night owl crowd.
cards.short_summary: A late-night fast food option on 125th Street open until 5:00 AM for late-night cravings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 161 East 125th St is open until 5:00 AM on Fridays.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in New York, NY - 161 East 125th ST
cards.access_notes: Open until 5:00 AM on select nights.

cards.title: The Neighborhood Study Spot
cards.subtitle: 3570 Broadway
cards.notes: A neighborhood staple with ample seating, Hamilton's serves coffee and pastries until 11 PM, making it a prime off-campus study alternative.
cards.short_summary: A spacious cafe and bakery on Broadway open until 11:00 PM daily, popular for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton's Cafe & Restaurant (Hamilton's Bakery) is open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Hamilton's Cafe & Restaurant (Hamilton's Bakery) - Uptown Guide
cards.access_notes: Open 9 AM - 11 PM Monday-Friday; 10 AM - 11 PM Saturday-Sunday.

cards.title: Late-Night Italian Comfort
cards.subtitle: 1600 Amsterdam Ave
cards.notes: Located right across from the CCNY campus, Fumo offers a lively atmosphere and Italian fare until 11 PM on weekends for a more formal late meal.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant located directly adjacent to campus, offering pasta and pizza until 11:00 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Fumo Harlem is open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Hours & Location | Fumo Restaurant in New York, NY
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday; 10:30 PM Tuesday-Thursday.

cards.title: The LaSalle Street Trattoria
cards.subtitle: 125 La Salle St
cards.notes: A short walk south to Morningside Heights leads to this cozy Italian spot, serving dinner until 10:30 PM on weekends for students seeking a quiet escape.
cards.short_summary: An Italian trattoria in Morningside Heights known for its sustainable practices and late weekend dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pisticci is open for dinner until 10:30 PM from Thursday to Saturday.
cards.source_title: DETAILS — Pisticci | Italian trattoria
cards.access_notes: Dinner served until 10:30 PM Thursday-Saturday; 10:00 PM Sunday-Wednesday.

cards.title: BBQ Under the Viaduct
cards.subtitle: 700 W 125th St
cards.notes: This iconic BBQ joint near the 125th Street waterfront offers a 15% student discount and stays open until 11 PM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A famous BBQ restaurant located under the Riverside Drive Viaduct, offering student discounts and late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Dinosaur Bar-B-Que Harlem is open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday and offers a 15% student discount with ID.
cards.source_title: Harlem BBQ | Restaurant & Catering NY - Dinosaur Bar-B-Que
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The 125th Street Sub Stop
cards.subtitle: 578 West 125th St
cards.notes: A quick stop for students using the 125th Street transit corridor, this Subway provides familiar sandwich options late into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop located on the busy 125th Street corridor, serving students late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Subway at 578 West 125th Street serves the Harlem community with late-night availability.
cards.source_title: Sandwiches, Salads, Wraps & More | SUBWAY at 578 West 125th Street New York NY
cards.access_notes: Check local store for exact nightly closing times; typically open late.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student-preferred spaces at CCNY, from quiet library corners to active student centers and specialized lounges.

cards.title: Hoffman Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: North Academic Center (NAC), 1st Floor
cards.notes: Located near the Convent Avenue entrance, this lounge features a game room and social seating. It is a primary hub for students to relax between classes in the NAC.
cards.short_summary: A central social lounge and game room located on the first floor of the North Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hoffman Lounge is located on the first floor of the NAC and includes a game room for student use.
cards.source_title: LGBTQ+ Student Center - Contact Us - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open to CCNY students with valid ID during building hours.

cards.title: Music Library
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall, Room 160
cards.notes: A quiet, wood-paneled retreat in historic Shepard Hall. It offers 10 Mac stations and a vast collection of scores and recordings for focused study.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library in Shepard Hall known for its quiet atmosphere and extensive music resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library is located in Shepard Hall Room 160 and provides Mac stations and study space.
cards.source_title: Facilities | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday; check library website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Wingate Gaming Room
cards.subtitle: Wingate Hall, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Equipped with console and PC stations, this room serves as a dedicated space for the campus esports community and casual gaming.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student gaming facility located on the second floor of Wingate Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gaming Room in Wingate Hall features console and PC stations for student use.
cards.source_title: Gaming Room - Wingate Center: Student Center at City College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Valid CCNY ID required for entry and equipment use.

cards.title: Michael Sorkin Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Spitzer School of Architecture, Room 101
cards.notes: A light-filled space housing the personal collection of Professor Michael Sorkin. It features a long seminar table ideal for quiet reading and conversation.
cards.short_summary: A specialized architectural reading room and study space in the Spitzer School of Architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sorkin Reading Room opened in 2023 and is located within the Architecture Library at the Spitzer School.
cards.source_title: Sorkin Reading Room - The Bernard and Anne Spitzer School of Architecture
cards.access_notes: Accessible to CCNY members during Architecture Library hours.

cards.title: cITy Tech Center
cards.subtitle: NAC, 1st Floor (Room 1/301)
cards.notes: A massive computing hub with over 300 workstations and reservable media study rooms. It is the go-to spot for group projects and printing.
cards.short_summary: The primary student computing and technology center located on the ground floor of the Cohen Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tech Center in NAC 1/301 offers over 300 workstations and reservable media study rooms.
cards.source_title: Research and Study Facilities | City College Catalog - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Reservations for study rooms can be made in person at the center.

cards.title: MCA Lounge
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall, 4th Floor
cards.notes: A bright lounge area under a glass ceiling used by Media and Communication Arts students. It features couches and tables for casual meetings.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge in Shepard Hall known for its natural light and social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The MCA Lounge is located on the 4th floor of Shepard Hall and serves as a social and study space.
cards.source_title: MCA Facilities | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open during Shepard Hall academic hours.

cards.title: Science & Engineering Library Quiet Room
cards.subtitle: Marshak Building, Room 29
cards.notes: Tucked away in the Marshak Building, this library offers a silent environment preferred by STEM students for intensive focus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area within the Science & Engineering Library in the Marshak Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Science & Engineering Library is located in Marshak Room 29 and provides quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Directions to Library Buildings - CCNY Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday; check for specific library hours.

cards.title: Wingate Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Wingate Hall, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: A renovated historic gymnasium offering cardio and strength equipment. It is a popular spot for students to stay active between lectures.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus fitness facility located on the third floor of Wingate Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wingate Fitness Center is located on the 3rd floor of Wingate Hall and is open to the CCNY community.
cards.source_title: CCNY Campus Fitness and Recreation | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Valid CCNY ID required; open until 8:00 PM Monday-Thursday.

cards.title: The Writing Center
cards.subtitle: NAC, 3rd Floor (Amsterdam Plaza Entrance)
cards.notes: Beyond tutoring, this center provides a quiet computer lab with 26 Macs. It is a useful alternative to the main library for writing-intensive work.
cards.short_summary: An academic support center in the NAC providing tutoring and a quiet computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center is located on the 3rd floor of the NAC and includes a computer lab for student use.
cards.source_title: The Writing Center - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Friday is Zoom only.

cards.title: NAC Ballroom
cards.subtitle: North Academic Center, 1st Floor
cards.notes: A large multipurpose space used for student club events, cultural shows, and occasionally as an overflow study area during peak times.
cards.short_summary: A versatile event and gathering space on the first floor of the North Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The NAC Ballroom is a key venue for student life activities and is located on the first floor of the NAC.
cards.source_title: Student Life - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled events; check the Student Life calendar.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at CUNY City College, from historic halls and rooftop terraces to student-only fitness centers and public park events.

cards.title: Visit the Historic Great Hall
cards.subtitle: Historic assembly space in Shepard Hall
cards.notes: Walk through this neo-Gothic hall to see the 'The Graduate' mural. It is a quiet, awe-inspiring spot for reflection between classes when not in use for events.
cards.short_summary: A historic, cathedral-like assembly hall featuring a massive mural and neo-Gothic architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Hall in Shepard Hall is a historic space with a capacity of 600-1,000 and features the mural 'The Graduate'.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours (typically 7am-10pm) unless reserved for private ceremonies or lectures.

cards.title: Work Out at Wingate
cards.subtitle: Free gym for CCNY students
cards.notes: Use your student ID to access cardio machines, free weights, and an indoor track. It is a cost-free alternative to commercial gym memberships in Harlem.
cards.short_summary: A 6,000-square-foot fitness facility offering free gym access to the City College community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wingate Fitness Center is open to all members of the City College community for free with a valid CCNY I.D.
cards.source_title: Wingate Fitness Center - Facilities - The City College of New York Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8am-8pm and Friday 8am-4pm during the spring semester. Valid CCNY ID required.

cards.title: Relax on the Spitzer Rooftop
cards.subtitle: Outdoor terrace and amphitheater
cards.notes: Head to the roof of the Spitzer School for skyline views. Use the amphitheater seating for study groups or a quiet lunch break in the open air.
cards.short_summary: An elevated outdoor space featuring a paved terrace and amphitheater seating for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spitzer School rooftop amphitheater and terrace are open to students, faculty, and staff from 7am to 6pm, Monday through Friday.
cards.source_title: Rooftop and Amphitheater - The Bernard and Anne Spitzer School of Architecture
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the main atrium staircase or freight elevator. Open weekdays 7am-6pm.

cards.title: Study on the Quiet Floors
cards.subtitle: Silent study zones in North Academic Center
cards.notes: Find a desk on the 4th or 5th floors for guaranteed silence. These floors are dedicated to focused work without the distraction of group chatter.
cards.short_summary: Designated silent study areas located on the upper floors of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: In Cohen Library, the 4th and 5th floors are designated for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Can I use the library space to take online classes? - LibAnswers
cards.access_notes: Open during library operating hours; valid CUNY ID required for entry.

cards.title: Hang Out in St. Nicholas Park
cards.subtitle: Public park bordering the campus
cards.notes: Walk down the stairs from St. Nicholas Terrace to reach the park's lawns. It is a popular spot for outdoor reading and community events like Harlem Week.
cards.short_summary: A 23-acre public park adjacent to the CCNY campus offering lawns, sports courts, and historic sites.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Nicholas Park is a public park bordering the CCNY campus and hosts various free community events.
cards.source_title: St. Nicholas Park : NYC Parks
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible daily from 6am to 10pm.

cards.title: Browse the Atrium Gallery
cards.subtitle: Architecture exhibits in the Spitzer School
cards.notes: View rotating architectural models and design exhibits in this light-filled atrium. The gallery showcases work from both students and professional architects.
cards.short_summary: A public exhibition space within the Spitzer School of Architecture featuring design-focused displays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spitzer School Atrium Gallery hosts exhibits and is located at 141 Convent Avenue.
cards.source_title: Exhibits - The Bernard and Anne Spitzer School of Architecture
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during building hours, typically 9am-5pm on weekdays.

cards.title: Attend a Talent Showcase
cards.subtitle: Student performances in the NAC
cards.notes: Check the Student Life calendar for free events like the CCNY Talent Showcase. These gatherings often include free refreshments and campus merchandise giveaways.
cards.short_summary: A large multi-purpose venue in the North Academic Center that hosts free student-led performances and fairs.
cards.evidence_claim: The NAC Ballroom hosts events like the CCNY Talent Showcase, which is free for students and includes merch and refreshments.
cards.source_title: Student Appreciation Day - Department of Student Life
cards.access_notes: Access is typically for CCNY students and staff; specific event times vary.

cards.title: Lounge on Marshak Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor recreation space
cards.notes: Utilize the renovated plaza for outdoor seating and recreation. It serves as a central bridge between the North Campus and the athletic facilities.
cards.short_summary: A newly renovated outdoor plaza featuring athletic courts, a running track, and seating areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marshak Hall Plaza renovation provides a new outdoor recreation center with athletic courts, a track, and seating.
cards.source_title: Marshak Hall Plaza - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; accessible from Convent Avenue and St. Nicholas Terrace.

cards.title: Socialize at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Lounge in NAC Room 6/289
cards.notes: Drop by the 6th floor of the NAC to meet other students. This lounge is designed for relaxing and socializing between classes in a casual environment.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student lounge on the 6th floor of the North Academic Center for meeting and relaxing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center in NAC room 6/289 is a place for all CCNY students to meet, study, and socialize.
cards.source_title: First-Year Experience - Colin Powell School
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday during standard academic hours.

cards.title: Get Free Writing Tutoring
cards.subtitle: Academic support in NAC 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Schedule a free session with a tutor to review your essays or lab reports. The center also offers computer stations for student use while you work.
cards.short_summary: An academic resource center providing free one-on-one tutoring and computer lab access for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writing Center offers free tutoring and has 26 MACs and a computer lab for student use.
cards.source_title: The Writing Center | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday; appointments are recommended but walk-ins may be available for computer use.

cards.short_summary: The CCNY library branch located at the Center for Worker Education in Lower Manhattan.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Worker Education Library is located at 25 Broadway, 7th Floor.
cards.source_title: CCNY CWE Library | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open for study and research; check summer and semester schedules for hours.

cards.title: Classroom Study in Shepard
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall Rooms 51, 73, 75
cards.notes: Use these specific rooms in Shepard Hall for quiet study or attending online classes when they are not in use for instruction.
cards.short_summary: Designated rooms in Shepard Hall available for student study use.
cards.evidence_claim: Rooms 51, 73, and 75 in Shepard Hall are listed as available study spaces.
cards.source_title: Study Space on Campus | The City College of New York - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Students are asked to speak quietly and use headsets.

cards.title: Media Communication Arts Lounge
cards.subtitle: Shepard Hall 4th Floor
cards.notes: Study under the glass ceiling in this lounge. It features couches and tables, making it suitable for casual reading.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each

cards.title: Cafe One on Amsterdam
cards.subtitle: Amsterdam Avenue & West 140th Street
cards.notes: Visit this corner cafe for standard student fare like paninis and muffins; it is a convenient stop located directly across from the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: A convenient corner cafe on Amsterdam Avenue popular with students for quick lunches and coffee.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe One is located at 1619 Amsterdam Avenue at the corner of 140th Street and is a convenient place for students to grab lunch or dessert.
cards.source_title: Cafe One – New York, NY - Harlem One Stop

cards.title: The Grange on Convent

cards.title: Sugar Hill Cafe Hub

cards.evidence_claim: Sugar Hill Cafe is located at 410 W 145th St and is known as a favorite place for students to study and read.

cards.title: St. Nicholas Park Slopes

cards.evidence_claim: St. Nicholas Park borders the City College campus on the east and runs from 128th to 141st Streets.

cards.title: The Broadway Corridor
cards.subtitle: Broadway & West 137th Street

cards.short_summary: The primary subway access point for CCNY, surrounded by local commercial services.
cards.evidence_claim: The 137 St-City College station on Broadway serves as a primary transit point for the college.
cards.source_title: 137 St-City College | MTA

cards.title: The Gatehouse on 135th

cards.notes: Attend a performance at this restored 19th-century pump house; it serves as a major cultural venue for Harlem's performing arts.
cards.short_summary: A historic landmark and performing arts venue located at the southern end of the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Harlem Stage is located in the Gatehouse at 150 Convent Avenue at West 135th Street.
cards.source_title: About Us — Harlem Stage
cards.access_notes: Check the official website for performance schedules and box office hours.

cards.title: Tsion Cafe Culture

cards.notes: Experience Ethiopian and Middle Eastern cuisine at this Sugar Hill landmark; it often hosts live music and community art events.
cards.short_summary: A cultural destination in Sugar Hill offering Ethiopian cuisine and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Tsion Cafe is located at 763 St. Nicholas Ave and specializes in Ethiopian and Middle Eastern cuisine.
cards.source_title: Tsion Cafe: New York City Restaurant, Harlem - NYC Tourism
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner on weekdays and brunch on weekends.

cards.title: Chipped Cup on Hamilton
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Place & West 143rd Street
cards.notes: Grab a latte at this basement-level coffee shop known for its cozy garden seating and student-friendly work environment.
cards.short_summary: A popular neighborhood coffee shop with a hidden garden, located just north of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chipped Cup is located at 3610 Broadway (near Hamilton Place) and is a recommended cafe for studying in the area.
cards.source_title: The Chipped Cup

cards.title: Home Sweet Harlem Bistro
cards.subtitle: Amsterdam Avenue & West 135th Street
cards.notes: Enjoy American comfort food at this plant-filled bistro; it offers free Wi-Fi and is a popular spot for remote work and weekend brunch.
cards.short_summary: A cozy bistro on Amsterdam Avenue known for comfort food and a welcoming study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Home Sweet Harlem is located at 1528 Amsterdam Ave and offers free wifi for customers to do homework or work remotely.
cards.source_title: Home Sweet Harlem: Must-Try Restaurant in Harlem, NY

cards.title: Jackie Robinson Park Edge

cards.notes: Visit the recreation center or pool at this historic park; it serves as a major community hub just a few blocks north of the college.
cards.short_summary: A historic 12-acre park featuring a large pool and recreation center near the Hamilton Heights district.
cards.evidence_claim: Jackie Robinson Park is located at West 145th Street and Edgecombe Avenue, near the City College campus.
cards.source_title: Jackie Robinson Park : NYC Parks
cards.access_notes: Park open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM; pool hours vary seasonally.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and historic practices of the 'Harvard of the Proletariat,' from the recitation of the Ephebic Oath to the passing of the 1875 Loving Cup.

cards.title: The Ephebic Oath Recitation
cards.subtitle: A Civic Pledge at Commencement
cards.notes: Recite this historic Athenian-inspired pledge during commencement to vow lifelong devotion and service to the betterment of New York City.
cards.short_summary: A traditional civic pledge recited by graduates at commencement, emphasizing devotion to New York City.
cards.evidence_claim: At commencement each year, City College students participate in a long-standing tradition of reciting the Ephebic Oath, pledging devotion to the City of New York.
cards.source_title: Some Uniquely CCNY Commencement Traditions | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the main commencement ceremony on the South Campus Great Lawn.

cards.title: The 50-Year Loving Cup Handover
cards.subtitle: A Generational Symbol of Loyalty
cards.notes: Witness the ceremonial passing of this engraved silver trophy, bequeathed every 50 years to bridge the gap between generations of alumni.
cards.short_summary: A silver trophy bequeathed by the Class of 1875 to be passed down every 50 years as a symbol of loyalty.
cards.evidence_claim: The Class of 1875 Loving Cup was bequeathed to the graduating class 50 years in the future; it was passed to the Class of 1925, then 1975, and is held in trust for 2075.
cards.source_title: Some Uniquely CCNY Commencement Traditions | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Ceremonially displayed and passed during milestone Homecoming and Commencement events.

cards.title: Singing 'Lavender, My Lavender'
cards.subtitle: The Official School Song
cards.notes: Join the chorus of the official school song, written in 1901, which punctuates every commencement as graduates depart their alma mater.
cards.short_summary: The official school song of CCNY, written in 1901 and sung consistently at every commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: Since 1919, 'Lavender, My Lavender' has been the only song, other than the national anthem, sung consistently at CCNY commencements.
cards.source_title: Some Uniquely CCNY Commencement Traditions | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Performed at all official college ceremonies, including Freshman Convocation and Commencement.

cards.title: The Lavender Ceremony
cards.subtitle: LGBTQIA+ Achievement Celebration
cards.notes: Participate in this cultural celebration to receive a lavender cord and rainbow tassel, honoring the achievements of LGBTQIA+ graduates.
cards.short_summary: An annual ceremony celebrating the academic and personal achievements of LGBTQIA+ students and allies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lavender Ceremony is a cultural celebration that recognizes LGBTQ+ students and acknowledges their achievements with lavender cords and rainbow tassels.
cards.source_title: Lavender Ceremony | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May at Aaron Davis Hall; registration is required for graduates.

cards.title: The Great Hall Convocation
cards.subtitle: Academic Procession and Welcome
cards.notes: Walk in the academic procession through the historic Great Hall to be officially welcomed by the President and faculty in full regalia.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome ceremony for incoming freshmen, featuring an academic procession in the Great Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Annual Freshman Convocation occurs each September in the Great Hall and features an academic procession of deans and faculty in academic regalia.
cards.source_title: Freshman Convocation | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Held every September in Shepard Hall's Great Hall for the incoming freshman class.

cards.title: The Concrete Canoe Launch
cards.subtitle: Grove School Engineering Tradition
cards.notes: Join the Grove School of Engineering to design and race a functional canoe made entirely of concrete in regional and national competitions.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing engineering tradition where students build and race canoes made of concrete.
cards.evidence_claim: The Concrete Canoe club from The Grove School of Engineering is an old CCNY tradition where teams build canoes out of concrete to see if they float.
cards.source_title: CCNY students go the distance in Concrete Canoe | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: The club operates out of the Grove School of Engineering; competitions occur annually in the spring.

cards.title: Benny the Beaver's Appearance
cards.subtitle: Symbol of Industry and Endeavor
cards.notes: Look for Benny the Beaver at athletic events; he was chosen in 1934 to represent the intelligence and industry of the City College student body.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of CCNY, selected in 1934 as a symbol of intelligence and industry.
cards.evidence_claim: In 1934, the beaver was selected as the mascot for City College as a symbol of intelligence, industry, and earnest endeavor.
cards.source_title: City College of New York - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Appears at various CUNYAC athletic games and major campus spirit events.

cards.title: The Graduate Mural Viewing
cards.subtitle: Symbolic Passing of Wisdom
cards.notes: Study the massive Edwin Blashfield mural in the Great Hall, which depicts the Alma Mater passing the torch of wisdom to a young scholar.
cards.short_summary: A historic mural in the Great Hall that serves as a symbolic backdrop for major academic ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Edwin H. Blashfield's original mural titled 'The Graduate' anchors the Great Hall, depicting the passing of wisdom from The Alma Mater onto a young scholar.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Visible during events in the Great Hall of Shepard Hall; access depends on building hours.

cards.title: The Townsend Harris Medal Gala
cards.subtitle: Honoring Distinguished Alumni
cards.notes: Attend the annual Alumni Gala to see the presentation of the Townsend Harris Medal, the highest honor for graduates' career accomplishments.
cards.short_summary: An annual tradition honoring outstanding alumni with the Townsend Harris Medal at a formal gala.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alumni Association honors alumni for career accomplishments with the esteemed Townsend Harris Medal during the Annual Alumni Gala.
cards.source_title: Events - CCNY Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: The gala is a ticketed event held annually, often in Shepard Hall or external venues.

cards.title: Five Demands Commemoration
cards.subtitle: Student Activism Legacy
cards.notes: Visit the Archives to view artifacts from the 1969 student takeover, a recurring theme in campus exhibits that honors the fight for open admissions.
cards.short_summary: A recurring historical exhibit and commemoration of the 1969 student protest that led to open admissions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Archives & Special Collections Room showcases materials from the Five Demands student protest and takeover of the campus in 1969.
cards.source_title: City College Exhibit Covers Student Life History - Harlem View
cards.access_notes: Located in the NAC building, Room 5/301; check library hours for access to the Archives.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at CUNY City College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A guide for new students to navigate their first weekend at CCNY, featuring essential campus landmarks, local history, and student life hubs.

cards.title: Move-In at The Towers
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Check into your new home at 401 West 130th Street. Use your designated time slot to unload and meet your Resident Assistant (RA) for floor orientation.
cards.short_summary: The official on-campus residence hall for CCNY students.
cards.evidence_claim: The official move-in date for Fall 2026 is Saturday, August 22, 2026, with designated time slots starting at 8:30 am.
cards.source_title: FAQs - Move-In
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents and authorized guests with card-access entry.

cards.title: Lunch at the NAC Café
cards.subtitle: Saturday Midday Refuel
cards.notes: Visit the North Academic Center's main dining area for a quick meal. It is a central hub for meeting fellow new students during move-in weekend.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility located within the North Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The NAC Café (The Lodge) is a primary dining location on campus with ample seating in the cafeteria.
cards.source_title: Dining Services - The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Open to students and staff; typical weekday hours are 8am-6pm, check for weekend orientation hours.

cards.title: Walk Through St. Nicholas Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Exploration
cards.notes: Explore the 28-acre park bordering the campus. It offers a scenic route between the campus buildings and the surrounding Harlem neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A public park adjacent to the CCNY campus featuring historic landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Nicholas Park is a spacious park that has been a focus of community and City College 'Take Back' initiatives since 1995.
cards.source_title: St. Nicholas Park Highlights - NYC Parks
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from 6:00 am to 10:00 pm.

cards.title: Visit Alexander Hamilton's Home
cards.subtitle: Saturday Cultural Stop
cards.notes: Tour the relocated home of Alexander Hamilton. The visitor center in the basement offers free exhibits on his life and legacy in New York.
cards.short_summary: The historic home of Alexander Hamilton located within St. Nicholas Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The visitor center is open Wednesday through Sunday, 10:00 am - 5:00 pm, and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Basic Information - Hamilton Grange National Memorial
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday-Sunday; guided tours of the historic floor are free and first-come, first-served.

cards.entity_name: The Great Hall in Shepard Hall
cards.title: Admire the Great Hall
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Architecture
cards.notes: Step inside the neo-Gothic Shepard Hall to see the Great Hall. Look for the 'The Graduate' mural, which symbolizes the college's mission of wisdom.
cards.short_summary: A historic 1,520-seat theater and assembly space in Shepard Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The historic Great Hall features Edwin H. Blashfield's mural 'The Graduate' and is a centerpiece of the campus.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Access may be limited during private events; generally viewable during building hours.

cards.title: Get Your CCNY Gear
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Shopping
cards.notes: Pick up your official City College apparel and supplies. It's the best place to find 'Beaver' mascot merchandise before classes start.
cards.short_summary: The official university bookstore for CCNY.
cards.evidence_claim: Benny's Campus Store provides official CCNY merchandise and is located in the North Academic Center.
cards.source_title: News & Events | The City College of New York
cards.access_notes: Located in NAC 0/201; check website for specific weekend hours during orientation.

cards.title: Stargaze at the Planetarium
cards.subtitle: Sunday Science Experience
cards.notes: Located in the basement of the Marshak Science Building, this immersive theater hosts live space shows and tours of the universe.
cards.short_summary: An immersive science theater located in the Marshak Science Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The CCNY Planetarium hosts live space shows, often on Wednesday afternoons, but also for special orientation events.
cards.source_title: Current Shows | CCNY Planetarium
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of Marshak; reservations are recommended for shows.

cards.title: Connect with Student Life
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Prep
cards.notes: Visit the Student Life office to learn about the 200+ student-run organizations and how to get involved in campus activities.
cards.short_summary: The central office for student organizations and leadership development.
cards.evidence_claim: The Department of Student Life is located in NAC 1/210 and works with over 200 student-run organizations.
cards.source_title: Student Life and Leadership Development
cards.access_notes: Standard office hours are Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm.

cards.title: Check Out the Gym
cards.subtitle: Monday Afternoon Workout
cards.notes: Locate the fitness center in Wingate Hall. It features cardio equipment, free weights, and an indoor track for student use.
cards.short_summary: The primary fitness and recreation facility for the CCNY community.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingate Fitness Center is located on the 3rd floor of Wingate Hall and is open to all members of the City College community.
cards.source_title: Wingate Fitness Center - Facilities
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid CCNY ID; typically closed on weekends, reopening Monday morning.

cards.title: Relax on the Quad
cards.subtitle: Monday Evening Wind Down
cards.notes: Find a spot on the grass in the central Quad. It's a prime location for studying outdoors or meeting friends between classes.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor gathering space on the CCNY campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quad is a featured stop on campus tours and serves as a central gathering point for students.
cards.source_title: CCNY Video Campus Tour
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor space accessible to the public and students.
